YOU WILL SEE A MAN OF GOD DOING FINE AND GREAT UNDER A FOUNDER OF A DENOMINATION.

September 20 3 min read Latunde Akin

YOU WILL SEE A MAN OF GOD DOING FINE AND GREAT UNDER A FOUNDER OF A DENOMINATION.
MOMENT HE LEAVES TO START A FRESH WORK,IT WILL LOOK LIKE HE WAS DOING WELL AND LATER STOP DOING WELL
You won't hear about his exploit again. He will enter silent mode of operation and people will be wondering whether he is the same man of God they once knew.
Why?
What a lot of us fail to realize is that,the angel of the church where many once worked with was the one backing them. And when they left the angel stopped working with them.
If they must secure the continuity of the use of that angel,the founder is the one to activate it.Or that there is something you keep doing to ensure you remain under cover.
You may see a founder praying and sending forth their pastors to start fresh work independently while in their heart they are not actually releasing anybody. The prayer and send forth is just to fulfill all righteousness.
In that case, that doesn't make the person leaving a wrong person. He only needs to understand how not to start the work immediately by seeking direction from the Lord and receive the backing of a greater angel from God. His own personal angel doesn't have that strength yet,so the need for him never to be carried away by the anointing
.
If he has offended church administration in the past,he must settle it. If he has disobeyed in the past he must calm down first and make his way right.
Reason Pastor Kumuyi made a great leap and success while disobeying the church leaders in Apostolic Faith Church then was because he had secured a greater support from the Lord. God had released the stronger angel to him,so the angel of his former church can't stand to withstand agathe assignment given to him from God. All their persecutions or silent prayer against his disobedience to them can't work. Afterall,he was obeying God but that wasn't what saved him to succeed.
A lot of people have obeyed God genuinely like that in the past by disobeying their former denomination rules. Yet they entered oblivion because they failed to secure a greater covenant with God for the assignment ahead of them.
There are ranks in God too, and people must be very strategic and wiser because those ranks can withdraw themselves from you and leave you empty while you think it is your anointing working. Especially if you don't strive to closely examine your own rank and stand with God before leaving.
Yet in all,it is your level of humility that offers you such ability to discern the kind of spiritual technology going on around your life and service to God.
If you're are an ordinary member of a church. Simply understand that leaving a church should be done peacefully and never without any bitterness in your heart. Whether they offended you or you offended them, bitterness must be avoided at all cost because it is that energy emmited by bitterness that will be used against you in the spiritual space. Forgive and let them also forgive you. If you sek forgiveness and they refuse. Don't worry, simply move on without bitterness. The king of this world must not find any negative energy to use against you.
Leave still if you don't find your spiritual life comfortable but you must have known where you are going before leaving by staying put before God in deep fellowship.
We will all succeed in God in Jesus name. Amen
A word is enough for the wise.
Your brother,
Latunde Akin
